snippet.title: Psychic Detective gameplay (PC Game, 1995)
snippet.description:
NOTE: the introduction can be barely seen. Skip to 03:24 to watch the gameplay directly. Apologies for the inconvenience!

Introduction and gameplay for Psychic Detective, Dos PC game produced by Electronic Arts in 1995 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/psychic-detective/8057/
Playing the first part of this interactive non linear adventure. The game plays like a movie and the story is about psychic powers and mystery...
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
